tests.name: RViz RobotModel green after wheel joint states
Late volatile subscriber: no message, exit=124
Defect reproduced: parent test fails, lidar at 0.56/0/0.76
Restored model: parent test passes, lidar at 0.28/0/0.38

defect.reproducer: Branch pr06-defect-lidar-parent, commit 0e64ab8233288df0e79ebef54d18503f9757f331. Changed only lidar_link parent from base_link to camera_link while preserving offset 0.28 0 0.38. test_lidar_parent_is_base_link failed with exit=1. check_urdf still accepted the tree. With one robot_state_publisher, tf2_echo measured 0.56 0 0.76.
defect.root_cause: The unchanged lidar offset became relative to camera_link instead of base_link. The camera translation was therefore added to the lidar translation. A connected, acyclic URDF tree can still contain a geometrically incorrect parent.
defect.proof_after: Stopped the defective publisher and returned to pr06. The same parent test passed, all five package tests passed and check_urdf exited with 0. With one publisher, tf2_echo measured 0.28 0 0.38 and view_frames showed base_link as the parent of lidar_link.
